body: Correction to my last mail on #4007: GitHub reports the new head d6eb35f081fd as CONFLICTING/DIRTY against integration, but `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/integration <head>` on this machine is clean (exit 0, integration 4a8875e2aa1). I merge locally, so the conflict report does not block me. What #4007 still needs is a verdict at d6eb35f081fd (the approval is at the old head 30e4a10ed702) and no hold. The lane should still run `cargo test -p aida-core git_ops` on that head (the bug034 lock test failed on the earlier merge result on dell1).
subject: Correction: #4007 merges cleanly here; it needs a verdict at d6eb35f081fd
